lyrics:
[Intro: stomp-clap beat, banjo riff, robotic voice: Recalculating]

[Verse 1: sassy female voice, half-spoken]
I had the whole route planned, six years, turn by turn
Ring, house, baby, in that order, I was sure
Then you missed the exit with a girl named Jade
And the little voice inside my dashboard said

[Chorus: full band, stomp-clap, crowd shouts]
(Recalculating!) Make a U-turn, honey
(Recalculating!) Keep the ring, keep the money
In a quarter mile I'm gonna be just fine
Left at the heartache, right at the wine
Don't need your directions, I got mine
(Recalculating!)

[Verse 2: sassy, rhythm tighter]
Now I'm two states over with the windows down
Singing with the trucker in the next lane out
You're calling, you're calling, well, look at that
No signal in the canyon. Imagine that.

[Chorus: full band, stomp-clap, crowd shouts]
(Recalculating!) Make a U-turn, honey
(Recalculating!) Keep the ring, keep the money
In a quarter mile I'm gonna be just fine
Left at the heartache, right at the wine
Don't need your directions, I got mine
(Recalculating!)

[Dance Break: fiddle solo, steps called over the beat]
Step to the left (your old address)
Step to the right (my brand-new place)
Turn it around (legal where you can)
Clap for the girl with a better plan

[Final Chorus: loudest, whole floor shouting]
(Recalculating!) Make a U-turn, honey
(Recalculating!) Keep the ring, keep the money
In a quarter mile I'm gonna be just fine
Left at the heartache, right at the wine
Don't need your directions, I got mine
(Recalculating!)

[Outro: banjo riff, robotic voice: You have arrived]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 110 BPM, 4/4, A minor. A hard stomp-clap strut, built for a row of boots.

VOICE: Female, mid-range, dry and sarcastic, half-spoken in the verses with words landing on the beat, sung with an edge in the chorus. A crowd shouts the title. A flat robotic navigation voice speaks at the start and end.

INSTRUMENTS: Stomps and handclaps as the main beat, a plucked banjo riff, fiddle, a thumping kick, electric bass, acoustic guitar, a twangy electric guitar answering the vocal.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, stomps, banjo, the robot voice. 0:09 Verse 1. 0:31 Chorus 1. 0:55 Verse 2. 1:17 Chorus 2. 1:41 Dance break, fiddle and called steps. 2:03 Final chorus. 2:30 Outro, 'You have arrived' at 2:44.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2024 dance-floor country: dry, punchy, stomps and claps as loud as the voice, plenty of space for a crowd.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first crowd shout of the title at 0:31.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original asks him why. This one does not need an answer: the comic chorus is a machine calmly finding another way, which is how grown people get over things.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Stung, sarcastic, moving, arrived.
